description: Whether a logical path has a component holding one of the five wildcard characters of Windows, " * < > ?, a folder's included: the type ntfs cannot remove such a name from its folder, or move it, without setting its whole volume read-only, so Atoll leaves a copy there at such a path as it is. Every other byte, the other characters NTFS forbids among them, and a character that only looks like one, is no wildcard.

cases.note: in a folder above the file
a name of that character alone
NTFS forbids a colon, but the type ntfs removes and moves it
nor a backslash or a vertical bar
a fullwidth question mark, U+FF1F, is another character
Films/a\xff?.mkv: a name that is not valid UTF-8 is read by its bytes
